summary: [spec fidelity] The reworded scenario and the brief ('ingest records and ingest plans') say export, artifacts store, ingest records and ingest plans run with --input, but the bound test loops over export, artifacts store and ingest records only: the 'ingest sessions' row was replaced by 'ingest records' and no 'ingest plans' row was added. Probed on the real binary: ingest plans --input '[{},{"dialect":"nope"}]' is USAGE at /1/planSource, and '[{},{}]' in an empty directory is BATCH_INCOMPLETE at /0 carrying CONFIG_REQUIRED in its message, so the behaviour holds; only the test is short of the text. The scenario's Then also says the valid batch answers CONFIG_REQUIRED while test and binary answer BATCH_INCOMPLETE /0 (older wording, unchanged). Blast radius: atip.constraints.23-25 batches are untouched.
